translations.profile.summary: Full-stack Computer Engineer. I build web applications end to end: interfaces with Angular and React, REST APIs with Node.js and NestJS, and relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB). I've taken serverless services on Google Cloud to production, along with a WhatsApp AI agent built with OpenAI and LangChain that processes text, images and audio. I use AI to support development, driven by specifications, and I keep code maintainable (Clean Architecture, SOLID).
translations.exp.canai.h6: Deployments to Google Cloud and production incident resolution from the logs; automations with n8n.

translations.project.cv.description: Chatbot that answers questions about my experience using only my CV, in Spanish or English. NestJS, LangChain and RAG with Gemini embeddings, streamed answers and Clean Architecture.
